description: Fetch the canonical amino-acid sequence (FASTA) for a UniProtKB accession, with length and the parsed header. Set include_isoforms to also return the alternatively-spliced isoform sequences. This is the cheap sequence-only path — for the full functional record use uniprot_get_entry. A merged accession returns the sequences of its merge target, labelled with the target accession and the requested one in mergedFrom; a demerged or deleted accession fails not_found naming its replacements or UniParc ID. Accessions come from uniprot_search_proteins or uniprot_map_ids; strip any "-N" isoform suffix (P04637-2 to P04637) before calling.

accession.description: UniProtKB primary accession, e.g. "P04637". Canonical form only — strip any "-N" isoform suffix.

include_isoforms.description: When true, also return the isoform sequences. Defaults to false (canonical only).

name: uniprot_get_sequence

accession.description: The accession whose sequences are returned — the requested one, or its merge target when mergedFrom is present.

header.description: The FASTA header line (without the leading ">"), e.g. "sp|P04637|P53_HUMAN Cellular tumor antigen p53 OS=Homo sapiens OX=9606 GN=TP53 PE=1 SV=4".

sequence.description: The amino-acid sequence as a single string (newlines removed).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The accession has no sequence in UniProtKB — unknown, or demerged or deleted; for an inactive accession the message names its replacements or UniParc ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

isoforms.description: Isoform sequence records. Present only when include_isoforms is true and isoforms exist.

header.description: The FASTA header line (without the leading ">"), e.g. "sp|P04637|P53_HUMAN Cellular tumor antigen p53 OS=Homo sapiens OX=9606 GN=TP53 PE=1 SV=4".

sequence.description: The amino-acid sequence as a single string (newlines removed).

mergedFrom.description: The requested accession, present only when UniProt merged it into accession; every record here is the merge target. Omitted for an active accession.

title: uniprot-mcp-server: get sequence
